_source: Tests discovered on main before the 2026-09 reorganization (git worktree of main, unittest discovery per suite), with the old model names mapped to the current ones (opp->opp_v1, opp_hc->opp_hc_1, opp_aco->opp_aco_1) and tier normal->functional. opp_v5_1_mono did not exist then: its counts (52 functional = opp_v5_2_split's 53 minus the one test that needs a separate stage 1; 8 stress) were collected from its own tree when it was added (2026-09-21). Regenerate with `python -m scripts.run_all --update-baseline` only when tests are added or removed on purpose.

functional/opp_v3.note: test_bridge_earliness_order_size: numeric-precision assertion, fails identically on main

functional/opp_v2.note: test_bridge_earliness_order_size: same big-M precision assertion as opp_v3 (1.2e+21 not <= 1e-06); fails identically on main

functional/opp_v1.note: test_3_orders_1_mission_1_picker (test_case_15, was test_opp_model_15): the output graph differs from the expected one; fails identically on main. The whole opp_v1 suite takes ~8 min (real SCIP solves).
